summary: feat(integrations): implement Phase 0 shared setup and neutral skill

decisions.problem: The bundled skill had client-specific defaults (client='antigravity') and version 2, and lacked guidance on client identification across agents and reporting unavailable tools.
decisions.choice: Update skill.md to version 3 with neutral client identification instructions (codex, antigravity, copilot_vscode, claude_code), tool unavailability warnings, and explicit notice that skill installation does not authorize commits.
decisions.rationale: A single client-neutral skill avoids identity collisions and doctor template mismatches during sequential multi-client setup.

decisions.problem: Codex and Copilot profiles used non-standard skill paths (.codex/skills/commitecho.md, .agents/skills/commitecho.md) and Codex used .codex/AGENTS.md, which is missed by root discovery.
decisions.choice: Standardize Codex and Copilot on .agents/skills/commitecho/SKILL.md, set Codex instruction_path to root AGENTS.md, and add safe legacy file migration that preserves custom modifications.
decisions.rationale: Conforms to documented directory-based skill discovery conventions and root AGENTS.md discovery while safely cleaning up known generated legacy files.

decisions.problem: serve --repo defaulted to '.', defeating environment variable fallbacks; setup opened draft/index databases during dry-run, creating private files unexpectedly.
decisions.choice: Change serve --repo to default=None to implement strict precedence (explicit --repo -> COMMITECHO_REPO -> CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR -> cwd discovery), avoid opening databases in setup/dry-run, and add --portable support.
decisions.rationale: Guarantees reliable stdio server startup in diverse client harnesses without breaking existing explicit paths, and ensures dry-run is truly side-effect free.
